verdict.rationale: Ashby markets an integrated 'CRM & Sourcing' module and AI-driven candidate rediscovery/matching, and positions itself as an all-in-one platform 'from outreach to offer,' suggesting sourcing pools live in-app rather than a separate tool. However, the evidence pack gives no detail on personalized email sequence building, email open/click tracking, or nurture-campaign workflows for future roles. Missing for 10: documented email sequencing features, tracking/analytics on outreach emails, and nurture-campaign specifics/screenshots or third-party confirmation.
